index.title: Congrats products — digital gifts and invitations for every Egyptian occasion
index.description: Love-story pages, digital Eidiya, katb ketab invitations, the full wedding package, sebou3, graduation, birthday surprises and corporate greetings — make it yourself or let us make it on WhatsApp.
index.intro: Each product is built for one Egyptian occasion. Make it yourself in minutes, or message us on WhatsApp and we make it for you.

page.demoLabel: Live preview of a real design
page.demoHint: A live preview of the design — exactly what they receive.
page.mockHint: An illustration of what we prepare for you.
page.pricingSubtitle: Pay once by InstaPay. Anything marked “Coming soon” is still being built and isn’t part of the price.

pay.a: By InstaPay. Transfer the amount, upload the screenshot and reference number, and the link goes live once our team confirms — usually within {review}.

app.a: Neither you nor the recipient. Everything runs in the phone’s browser; they just tap the link.

time.a: You make it yourself in minutes on your phone, with a live preview as you type. Want us to make it? Message us on WhatsApp and we confirm timing before you pay.

timeService.a: Send us the details on WhatsApp and we confirm timing and the final price before you pay anything.

edit.a: Yes. Your card is saved in your account and any change you save shows on the same link — no new link to send.

editService.q: What if I want a change after it’s done?
editService.a: Send us the change on WhatsApp and we update it on the same link.

soon.a: Features we are still building — not available yet, and not part of what you pay for. If you need one now, message us and we’ll see how we can do it for you.
